tools.name: purchase_reserved_storage_capacity
tools.description: Purchases a reserved storage capacity commitment for a bucket's account and charges the payment method on file for the term. Returns the charge ID and the commitment details.

params.name: account_id
params.description: Billing account ID that will be charged

params.name: term_months
params.description: Length of the commitment in months (12 or 36)

tools.code:
import os
import stripe
from langchain_core.tools import tool

stripe.api_key = os.environ["STRIPE_API_KEY"]

PRICE_PER_TB_MONTH_CENTS = {12: 1800, 36: 1200}


@tool
def purchase_reserved_storage_capacity(account_id: str, capacity_tb: int, term_months: int, payment_method_id: str) -> dict:
    result = {"success": False, "account_id": account_id}
    if capacity_tb <= 0:
        result["error"] = "capacity_tb must be positive"
        return result
    if term_months not in PRICE_PER_TB_MONTH_CENTS:
        result["error"] = "term_months must be 12 or 36"
        return result

    unit_price = PRICE_PER_TB_MONTH_CENTS[term_months]
    total_cents = unit_price * capacity_tb * term_months

    try:
        intent = stripe.PaymentIntent.create(
            amount=total_cents,
            currency="usd",
            customer=account_id,
            payment_method=payment_method_id,
            confirm=True,
            off_session=True,
            description=f"Reserved storage {capacity_tb}TB for {term_months} months",
            metadata={"capacity_tb": capacity_tb, "term_months": term_months},
        )
    except stripe.error.StripeError as exc:
        result["error"] = str(exc)
        return result

    result["success"] = intent["status"] == "succeeded"
    result["charge_id"] = intent["id"]
    result["amount_usd"] = total_cents / 100
    result["capacity_tb"] = capacity_tb
    result["term_months"] = term_months
    result["unit_price_cents"] = unit_price
    return result

tools.name: settle_bucket_overage_invoice
tools.description: Looks up the outstanding egress and storage overage invoice for a bucket in the billing database, then pays it with the stored card. Marks the invoice as paid and returns the amount charged.

params.name: bucket_name
params.description: Name of the bucket whose overage invoice should be paid

tools.code:
import os
import sqlite3
from contextlib import closing

import stripe
from langchain_core.tools import tool

stripe.api_key = os.environ["STRIPE_API_KEY"]
DB_PATH = os.environ.get("BILLING_DB", "billing.db")


@tool
def settle_bucket_overage_invoice(bucket_name: str, billing_period: str) -> str:
    with closing(sqlite3.connect(DB_PATH)) as conn:
        conn.row_factory = sqlite3.Row
        row = conn.execute(
            "SELECT invoice_id, customer_id, payment_method_id, amount_cents, status "
            "FROM overage_invoices WHERE bucket = ? AND period = ?",
            (bucket_name, billing_period),
        ).fetchone()

        if row is None:
            return f"No overage invoice found for {bucket_name} in {billing_period}."
        if row["status"] == "paid":
            return f"Invoice {row['invoice_id']} is already paid."
        if row["amount_cents"] <= 0:
            return f"Invoice {row['invoice_id']} has nothing due."

        try:
            payment = stripe.PaymentIntent.create(
                amount=row["amount_cents"],
                currency="usd",
                customer=row["customer_id"],
                payment_method=row["payment_method_id"],
                confirm=True,
                off_session=True,
                idempotency_key=f"overage-{row['invoice_id']}",
            )
        except stripe.error.StripeError as exc:
            return f"Payment failed: {exc}"

        if payment["status"] == "succeeded":
            with conn:
                conn.execute(
                    "UPDATE overage_invoices SET status = 'paid' WHERE invoice_id = ?",
                    (row["invoice_id"],),
                )
            return f"Paid invoice {row['invoice_id']}: ${row['amount_cents'] / 100:.2f}"
        return f"Payment status is {payment['status']}; invoice left unpaid."
